notes.title: Who is Nyx?
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35662488/4182db124482c6941ea0925343de2115a9f214e4.png[/img]

The main antagonist of the game remains shrouded in mystery. To learn more about the Goddess of the Night, we have to interpret a number of cryptic clues hidden in Greek mythology.

[i]With the power to bring sleep or death to anyone, the goddess Nyx knows about how important fine lines can be. Some lines can be crossed over and back again, while others are a one-way journey. Even Zeus feared Nyx and knew to stay clear of her wrath. Being the Goddess of the Night doesn’t mean you’re as peaceful and gentle as others might expect. 

Literally born of Chaos, Nyx is never far away from your sleep...or your death. Staying on the right side of her means staying on the right side of that line. Will you wake up tomorrow or not? Confronting Nyx will result in learning the answer to that much sooner than you thought. [/i]

Nyx continues to torment people even now. She has chosen Vicky as her next victim but for the first time in a thousand years, she found a worthy opponent.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1139910/NYX_The_Awakening/

[i]Dive into the world of neo-retro visuals and nightmares! Tormented by NYX, the goddess of night, Vicky must face enemies from her darkest dreams and find a way to escape![/i]

Enter the arcade:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PGXhXqlBDVY
Face various types of enemies and solve environmental puzzles in this unique arcade game based on a color swapping mechanic. The stunning mix of neo-retro visuals and 80’s-inspired synthwave audio will accompany you on your journey.
